FN-W1ZPP99-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 285
Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 285 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain citing agencies by a
small, undetermined amount dependent on the cost to notify a parent, legal guardian, or legal
custodian of a minor issued a traffic citation.
Page 1
